title: 第3章 第一次穿越异界第4章 第二次穿越验证
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 校官的眼睛一直盯着林默，似乎想要从脸上看出什么端倪。
化验的初步结果确实已经出来了。
而且结果显然和常规认知不太对得上，否则这位大人不会亲自坐在这里。
军区随便派个连级干部就能应付一个“精神病患者”的撒野事件。
能让校级来审讯，说明那块石头已经引起了足够高的重视。
校官沉默了几秒。
然后他侧头看向身旁那位拎着工作箱的女同事。
女军官会意，打开箱子，从里面取出一台笔记本电脑，翻转屏幕朝向校官。
屏幕上显示的是一张复杂的光谱分析图。
在他的化学知识里，红色标注通常意味着“异常”或“无法识别”。
校官盯着屏幕看了十几秒，面色依旧紧绷。
女军官低声在他耳边说了几句话。
林默竖着耳朵也没听清。
但他清楚地看到，校官听完之后，眼神变了。
校官合上笔记本，深呼一口气，重新看向林默。
“暂且跳过这个话题，你先详细说说你说的那个世界，包括前因后果。”
林默心头一松。
鱼咬钩了。
“那个世界我目前只去了两次，每次都是睡着之后意识被传送过去的。”
于是，林默开始详细讲述起自己的穿越经历。
末日之下人们更加内卷，他在外找不到糊口的工作，加上身上又没钱了，饿的受不了，就回到了出租屋。
想着就这么睡过去也好，下辈子再也不来了，结果......
异世界，莫名木屋内。
床上的林默咂了咂嘴，感觉枕头又香又软，还带着丝丝凉意。
雨后森林清新加好闻香味钻进鼻子，让他下意识用脸颊蹭了蹭。
舒服又温馨。
一声嘤咛在他耳边响起，空灵软糯。
等等！
枕头怎么会说话？
林默一个激灵，眼睛瞬间睁开。
一张俏丽的脸蛋撞了进来。
content_en:
The school officer kept his eyes on Lin Mo, as if he wanted to see something from his face.
The preliminary results of the laboratory tests have indeed come out.
And the result is obviously not consistent with conventional wisdom, otherwise this gentleman would not be sitting here in person.
The military region can simply dispatch any company-level cadres to deal with a "mentally ill" incident.
Being able to be interrogated by the school level shows that the stone has attracted enough attention.
The school officer was silent for a few seconds.
Then he turned his head and looked at the female colleague next to him who was carrying a work box.
The female officer understood, opened the box, took out a laptop computer, and turned the screen to face the colonel.
Displayed on the screen is a complex spectrum analysis chart.
In his knowledge of chemistry, a red annotation usually means "abnormal" or "unrecognized."
The school officer stared at the screen for more than ten seconds, his face still tense.
The female officer whispered a few words in his ear.
Lin Mo pricked his ears and couldn't hear clearly.
But he clearly saw that the school officer's eyes changed after hearing this.
The school officer closed his notebook, took a deep breath, and looked at Lin Mo again.
"Skip this topic for now. Let's talk about the world you are talking about in detail, including the causes and consequences."
Lin Mo felt relieved.
The fish bit.
"I have only been to that world twice so far, and each time my consciousness was transported there after I fell asleep."
So, Lin Mo began to talk about his time-travel experience in detail.
People became more involved in the apocalypse. He couldn't find a job to make a living outside, and he had no money. He couldn't bear the hunger, so he returned to the rental house.
I thought it would be okay to just sleep and never come again in the next life, but...
…
A different world, inside an inexplicable wooden house.
Lin Mo smacked his lips on the bed, feeling that the pillow was fragrant and soft, with a hint of coolness.
The fresh and pleasant scent of the forest after the rain penetrated his nose, causing him to subconsciously rub it with his cheek.
Comfortable and cozy.
"Well..."
A cry sounded in his ears, ethereal and soft.
etc!
How can pillows talk?
Lin Mo was startled and his eyes opened instantly.
A pretty face bumped in.
title_en: Chapter 3 The First Time Traveling to Another World Chapter 4 The Second Time Traveling Verification
